comparison.objective: Candidate sets a gripper stop; PR-892 loads a filled syringe into a pump and advances its driver without dosing.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses two rotational tools with countertorque; PR-892 requires tight flange-slot alignment, cradle seating, and gentle linear approach to a plunger.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades lock retention after articulation; PR-892 grades syringe seating and near-contact of the driver while latching any excess plunger displacement as failure.
comparison.reason: Precision alignment is shared only at a generic level; the mechanisms and failure-sensitive abilities differ.
